scope: Posthoc exploratory follow-up on two exposed development images. Not held-out evaluation or novelty evidence.
hypothesis: The reviewer suggested that averaging token logits causes the weak one-bit ranking. Test whether replacing token means by per-query/per-head window maxima reduces local attention-output error.
aggregation: For every prefill text query and query head, take max of raw QK logits over eight tokens per window, then average those maxima across queries and heads.
unchanged: Same frozen replay engine, prefilling inputs, 2 FP16/3 INT4/3 INT2 window counts, first window FP16, resident quantizer and teacher-forced decode evaluation.
selection_inputs: Prefill Q/K only. Decode inputs are evaluation only.
metric: Mean relative L2 across layers and decode steps1–3 per image. Also report cosine and all per-step/layer rows for new arms.
decision_rule: One-bit max improves on one-bit mean only if error is lower on BOTH images; separately compare exact softmax mass and every deterministic control. Never interpret this development comparison as proof of usefulness or novelty.
